caption: The drawing is a line illustration of a long coat, viewed from the back, on a plain beige or light tan background. The coat features a high collar and long sleeves, with seam lines indicating the structure and tailoring of the garment. There are two buttons placed symmetrically at the waistline on either side of the center back seam. The coat has curved paneling on the back and the sleeves, as well as an overlapping vent at the bottom center. The figure also appears to be wearing pants visible below the hem of the coat, with stitching details indicated on the pant legs. The lines are consistently thin and black, and there are some small, irregular, faint yellowish-brown stains on the paper, both on the left side and lower portion of the drawing.
title: Boy's Coat and Trousers
